title: SOP-CS-014 Customer Complaint Handling and Refund Processing

expected_findings.quote: If the refund amount is above ₹10,000, the Finance Manager approves the refund within 3 business days.
expected_findings.note: Refunds from ₹5,000 to ₹10,000 inclusive have no approver.

expected_findings.quote: If the complaint is upheld and a refund is due:
expected_findings.note: An upheld complaint where no refund is due has no next step.

expected_findings.quote: the CSA who logged the complaint approves the refund
expected_findings.note: The same person logs the complaint and approves its refund.

expected_findings.quote: The team will verify the order details
expected_findings.note: No accountable role for order verification.

expected_findings.quote: The CSA responds to the customer promptly
expected_findings.note: 'Promptly' has no time limit.

expected_findings.quote: All complaints must be resolved within 5 business days of being logged.
expected_findings.note: High-value path allows 1 + 2 + 3 = 6 business days before payment is even submitted.

expected_findings.quote: The CSA attaches the Refund Approval Form (RAF) to the complaint record
expected_findings.note: The RAF is attached in step 4 but only completed in step 7.

expected_findings.quote: If the payment gateway rejects the refund, notify IT Support.
expected_findings.note: Nothing happens after IT Support is notified; the complaint never closes.

expected_findings.quote: If the payment gateway rejects the refund, notify IT Support.
expected_findings.note: No actor named for notifying IT Support.

expected_findings.quote: If the customer disputes the resolution, return to step 3.
expected_findings.note: Disputes can loop forever; no limit or exit to escalation.

expected_findings.quote: The Service Delivery Lead may send the complaint back to the Team Lead for rework.
expected_findings.note: Escalation can cycle between Team Lead and Service Delivery Lead; no terminal authority.

expected_findings.quote: If a complaint is unresolved after 48 hours, escalate it to the Service Delivery Lead.
expected_findings.note: 48 clock hours here vs business days everywhere else.

expected_findings.quote: If a complaint is unresolved after 48 hours, escalate it to the Service Delivery Lead.
expected_findings.note: Nobody owns the escalation.

expected_findings.quote: The CSA should verify the customer's identity before discussing account details.
expected_findings.note: 'Should' on a data-protection control; reads as optional.
